CustomField.description: Whose logic a tool of this type runs: Standard for Pluto Core's own tools, Flow for an admin-built Flow that a standard tool runs, Apex for a custom ITool class. Core copies it to each tool's Implementation Type so reports and reviews can separate them.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Standard and Flow are for the tool types Pluto Core ships. Choose Apex for a custom tool type.
CustomField.label: Implementation Type
